added_failures_note: the reviewed manifest records an after_suite arm at c43e39932 (completed true, failure_count 0, failure_ids []) and no baseline_suite, so the added count is taken from the readable head arm as 0

findings.text: blocking: the done-when requires comparing against DINA's em_coupling matrices in 105013/1 (DD 3.38.1, read with imas-python in that version); no code, gate log or record paragraph names that IDS, so half of the node's own checked deliverable is unperformed and unreported.

follow-on: the thickness-refinement gate computes upper_sampled_limit_hz and prints it but never asserts the 1% criterion, so a mesh regression that changed every coil impedance by 5% would still exit 0 and the convergence done-when could not fail.

follow-on: power_self_max_fraction compares receipt coil_inductance_h against the same power_convertor reference the reconciliation forced it to (build.py:242), so it is an input-consistency identity reading 4.44e-16 that cannot detect a sectioned-linkage regression; the raw 1.820%-disagreeing matrix is disclosed but ungated.

follow-on: terminal_impedance_spectrum solves eigh(diag(resistance), passive) inline, duplicating the passive eigenbasis owned by nova/circuit/passive.py:97 mode_system rather than extending it, so a change to the eigenbasis rule leaves the two out of step.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is the sectioned ITER conductor set; nova/imas/machine.py:472 MachineCoil.winding_sections and nova/circuit/conductor.py:120 subdivide_passive_thickness build the series sections and through-thickness layers the brief requires.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md and landing.md; they report 295 winding sections across 14 coils, 1312/2163 passive circuits, 0.29295% 12-to-6mm convergence through 5 kHz on 101 samples, a 1.28e-16 passive-removal control, and name the gate logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares nova/imas/machine.py, nova/imas/pulsedesign.py, nova/circuit, three test files, scripts/iter_sectioned_conductor_set, docs/research, docs/figures and the fragment; all 15 paths in git diff --stat 8f294d56..7a66f9d81 fall inside them.
